thread:
maya_support: :rotating_light: Customer report: multiple customers in EU2 seeing intermittent 502/504s and elevated tail latency since ~07:10 UTC. Tickets created: ZD#4219, ZD#4223. Some customers reporting timeouts in completions and streaming truncation.
ryan_neteng: pulling flow logs now. initial look shows increased TCP retransmits between our eu2-edge-pop and transit provider A's peer at 10.12.34.0/24 — small bursts of packet loss, not full outage. p95 latency up from 60ms -> 220ms.
alex_oncall: confirmed spikes in gateway 502 rate starting 07:08 UTC. Incident automated alert fired: hosted-api-gateway-eu2 5xx rate > 3% for 5m. Rolling alert to eng-sre and neteng.
eli_infra: seeing queue backlog on the eu2 ingress LB — connection drops causing backend upstream read timeouts. Logs: `upstream read timeout from backend instance i-0abc...`
sam_sre: past hour: 502 spike correlated with retransmit rate jump to ~4-6%. TCP retransmits visible at packet capture on eu2-edge. Will paste tcpdump snippet.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: no deployments in eu2 within the last 12 hours.
ryan_neteng: ran traceroute from eu2-edge to transit peer (abbreviated):
```traceroute to 10.12.34.1 (10.12.34.1), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.3 ms  0.2 ms  0.2 ms
 2  10.1.0.1  1.2 ms  1.1 ms  1.3 ms
 3  192.0.2.5  15.6 ms  15.7 ms  15.6 ms
 4  198.51.100.10  18.2 ms  250 ms  17.9 ms
 5  10.12.34.1  19.0 ms  19.1 ms  19.0 ms
``` 
ryan_neteng: note the one sample at 250ms and occasional ttl increments — suggests intermittent fragmentation/PMTU blackhole or device queue causing sporadic large-packet drops.
maya_support: customers include search-saas and docsgen teams. search-saas reports requests with long prompt (avg 4k tokens) are more affected. Short queries less impacted.
eli_infra: that fits PMTU/fragmentation hypothesis — long requests result in larger TLS records during payload streaming. If large packets get dropped, you see retransmits and application timeouts.
alex_oncall: any recent ACL/MTU changes on our fabric?
ryan_neteng: no config changes on our side. I've opened provider ticket with transit-A (ticket TA-8831) — they acknowledge high error counts at their peering device and are investigating. ETA unknown.
lina_cse: escalating to affected customers with repro steps and mitigation suggestion: reduce chunk size / enable smaller TLS record size temporarily. Lined up a support KB.
sam_sre: mitigation options we can do from our side: 1) force smaller MSS on our edge egress for that peer (BFD/route-map tweak) 2) steer traffic to eu1 or eu3 region using smart routing policy for keys with high payloads 3) apply application-layer retry/backoff for streaming endpoints.
eli_infra: recommend immediate steering for heavy-stream customers to eu1 while provider fixes. I can patch routing policy to prefer alt peering for requests to models > 2k tokens. Needs quick PR and canary.
ryan_neteng: I'll prepare BGP-preference change. Note: steering will add +20ms median, but should remove packet-loss-induced retransmits.
maya_support: approved to notify customers: "We are seeing regional transit provider issues causing packet loss in EU2; recommended temporary mitigation: route heavy inference traffic to EU1 or reduce chunking sizes. Engineers are applying traffic steering now."
alex_oncall: patch ready; applying canary at 07:45 UTC to 10% of traffic -> monitor.
ops-bot: Canary rollout step: apply route preference change for prefix 203.0.113.0/24 -> new path via transit-B.
ryan_neteng: completed canary. Monitoring: 10% slice p95 down from 220ms -> 120ms, 5xxs in canary down by ~70%.
maya_support: customer update sent to ZD#4219 and ZD#4223. customers asked for ETA on full failover.
eli_infra: preparing full rollout, but need signoff from neteng for wider BGP policy.
ryan_neteng: will do full roll at 08:05 UTC if canary remains stable for 20m.
sam_sre: meanwhile, pushing a quick client-side workaround doc to customers: set smaller TCP MSS/disable TSO/GSO in app host for immediate improvement. Provide curl example: `curl --http2 -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" --data-binary @large_prompt.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete` and reduce chunk size to 4k bytes.
lina_cse: one large customer reported billing spike due to repeated retries; flagged to finance to avoid charging for retries while we investigate.
ops-bot: Alert: transit-A reports partial hardware fault at their aggregation switch, pursuing RMA but no ETA.
alex_oncall: because transit-A may be degraded for hours, preparing rollback plan to avoid flapping between paths. We'll prefer stable alternate transit-B until provider confirms fix.
ryan_neteng: full rollout completed at 08:06 UTC to route EU2-hosted inference egress through transit-B. Post-roll metrics: p95 latency for heavy requests ~110ms, retransmit rate down to 0.5%, 5xxs dropped to baseline.
maya_support: updating customers: deployed routing workaround; monitor for 1hr and will follow up.
eli_infra: marking incident status: recovering. Will keep monitoring KV cache hit ratios and connection pools for any residual errors.
sam_sre: follow-up action items: 1) add PMTU/MTU blackhole detection to eu2 synthetic tests 2) add automated steering runbook for transit path failures 3) postmortem once provider confirms root cause.
ryan_neteng: provider postmortem requested; include pcap and interface counters.
lina_cse: closing loop with customers — offering credits for impacted minutes and confirming billing exceptions.
maya_support: thanks team :heart: closing thread after postmortem.
